piston_door_2x2.name: 2×2 piston door
piston_door_2x2.description: Four sticky pistons close a 2×2 doorway flush with the wall. Lever on: closed, lever off: open.

piston_door_1x2.name: 1×2 piston door
piston_door_1x2.description: Two sticky pistons close a doorway one block wide and two blocks high. Lever on: closed.

observer_clock.name: Observer clock
observer_clock.description: Two observers facing each other. Very fast clock that starts as soon as it is built; break an observer to stop it.

repeater_clock.name: Repeater clock
repeater_clock.description: Adjustable clock from a redstone torch and two repeaters. It runs as soon as it is built; switch the lever on top on to stop it.

t_flip_flop.name: T flip-flop
t_flip_flop.description: Every input pulse toggles the output between on and off – turns a button into a switch.

rs_nor_latch.name: RS latch
rs_nor_latch.description: Memory cell: a signal on “set” turns the output on, a signal on “reset” turns it off.

and_gate.name: AND gate
and_gate.description: The output is on only while both inputs are on.

pulse_extender.name: Pulse extender
pulse_extender.description: Makes short signals longer: every input pulse is extended by three times the repeater delay.

item_sorter.name: Item sorter
item_sorter.description: Filters one item type out of a hopper line into a chest; all other items go on into the overflow chest. Load the filter hopper before use.

param.stackSize: Stack size of the sorted item (64: 41 in the filter, 16: 10 in the filter)

hidden_lamp_array.name: Hidden ceiling lights
hidden_lamp_array.description: Four redstone lamps with the wiring hidden above them, switched by one lever. Build it into a ceiling.
